data.gender_notes: Pardeep is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Deep in thought, deep in knowledge
data.long_meaning: Par deep means one who is absorbed in deep thought or deep knowledge. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'par' meaning 'above' and 'deep' meaning 'thought'. In Hindu mythology, Pardeep is a name of Lord Shiva, symbolizing his deep wisdom and understanding. The name Pardeep carries the meaning “Deep in thought, deep in knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Pardeep usually hope their child will grow to embody deep in thought, deep in knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pardeep total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
